# Spare the Dying (`spells:spare-the-dying`)
**[Necromancy](../magic-schools/necromancy.md) Cantrip** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** 15 feet
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md)

Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.
  Cantrip Upgrade. The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).
